verdict.rationale: Recurly's data imports let you bring customer data in to populate accounts and records across the account, and exports cover subscriptions, invoices and transactions. That amounts to bulk create and bulk read, but nothing shows bulk update or bulk action across many items. The other change-subscription and invoice-editing docs describe single-record operations. Missing for 10: documented bulk update or modify operations (e.g., mass subscription or price changes), bulk API endpoints or batch requests, AI or agent-driven bulk workflows, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
